name: io.github.flashdata-dev/youtube-metadata
title: YouTube Metadata — FlashData
description: YouTube video metadata, available chapters, statistics and formats. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with youtube_metadata access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Create a YouTube metadata and chapters brief
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0], including title, description and chapters when present. Pair chapter start_time/end_time with the video watch URL to prepare a navigation brief.
dev.flashdata.limits: Fields and chapters may be absent. Metadata does not include a transcript; transcript retrieval is a separate paid call.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
